findings.sourceReading: 申請条件の一つ is one condition for applying for authorization to draw the Red Key; it is not authorization itself. UP preserves the prerequisite distinction.
findings.alternative: The proclamation can practically help obtain power, but that does not erase the stated application and permission distinction.

findings.description: UP replaces recognition of the ordeal as a trial with inability to escape it.

findings.sourceReading: JP acknowledges this is indeed a trial; originalPC96664/96666 and MG retain identification. UP says I cannot get away from this trial, adding an escape constraint.
findings.alternative: The following discussion requires winning, making persistence plausible; it does not make the source identification identical to inability to escape.
